snippet.title: 💣 TAKE MY BOMB | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Take my bomb Steam page is now LIVE 🎮 
Wishlist it on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5134730/TAKE_MY_BOMB/?utm_source=youtube&utm_campaign=trailer+2026.09.24

Take my bomb is an online party game where up to 16 players shove a bubblegum bomb onto each other. It pops after 30 seconds, and takes anyone nearby with it. Only the one holding it can see the timer. As long as it's not you
